6.2.rationale: The retrieved sentences define and discuss “exploitation” and other forms of violence, but they do not explicitly mention human trafficking/trafficking in persons or trafficking victims, nor do they cite trafficking-specific legislation in the provided excerpts. 6.3.rationale: The excerpts address women and children victims of violence generally and mention “labor” only as a sector involved in prevention implementation, without identifying women workers/female employees as a specific target group or providing workplace-specific protection measures for women workers.

6.4.rationale: No cited sentence mentions elderly women or provides any special protection measures targeted to elderly women; the text focuses on women and children victims of violence generally.

6.5.rationale: The excerpts include a general non-discrimination principle and a definition of physical violence that can cause “disability,” but they do not identify people with disabilities (or women with disabilities) as a beneficiary group or provide disability-specific protections, accommodations, or services.

6.6.rationale: No cited sentence identifies women heads of household/families as a target group or provides special protection measures for them; references to “family” and “household” are definitional/general and not targeted to women-headed households.

6.7.rationale: The excerpts do not mention minority/isolated/indigenous/ethnic or religious minority women or any equivalent group as beneficiaries of protection or services; they only discuss women and children victims of violence generally.

6.12.rationale: No cited sentence mentions homelessness or women experiencing homelessness, and no special protection measures are directed to that group.

6.13.rationale: The excerpts do not mention former inmates/correctional institutions or formerly incarcerated women as a target group; “social reintegration” is discussed only in relation to victims returning to families/social environments, not post-incarceration status.
